summary: Frontend E2E verification of DynoPay First-run wizard (/get-started) and New-merchant dashboard hero (/dashboard) across brands 1, 165 and 179. All 11 scenarios executed. All spec-required data-testids, data-* attributes, validations, navigations, live preview, payment-link creation and share flow behave per spec. No legacy surfaces (wallet-setup-nudge, onboarding-checklist, dash2026-activation-checklist, dash2026-empty-hero) are rendered on /dashboard. No i18n raw keys observed. No horizontal overflow at 390/768/1280/1920. One disposable payment link was created on brand 165 as approved.
critical_code_review_comments: StepFirstLink.tsx WIDE breakpoint is @media (min-width: 1400px). Spec text says 'at 1920 preview side-by-side; at 1280 and 390 inside a collapsible'. In practice at 1280 the collapsible IS used (side-by-side only kicks in at >=1400). Behavior matches spec intent; note the exact numeric cutoff (1400 not 1280) if product wants strict 1280 side-by-side.

DashboardPreview.tsx: outer wrapper (gs-dashboard-preview) is interactive by design (contains the label). The faded content Box (inner) correctly sets pointer-events: none + aria-hidden + inert. If any automated checker inspects the OUTER element's aria-hidden/pointer-events, it will get a false negative — consider hoisting aria-hidden onto the outer node or renaming testids to disambiguate.

Share step: gs-share-summary text is a single node containing '$49.99 · description' — fine, but consider separate data-testids for amount vs description within the summary to make assertions cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Created ONE disposable payment link on brand 165 (Nameword) with amount 49.99 USD and description 'QA wizard test link — safe to delete' as explicitly approved in SAFE MODE. No other writes were performed. About-you form for brand 165 was re-saved with identical values (John / Nameword / Portugal) — safe no-op.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard + hero pass all spec cases. If retesting, note: (a) after creating a link, /get-started?step=link shows the gs-existing-link banner and the form/gs-preview-toggle are NOT rendered until you click gs-create-new-instead; that is expected and NOT a bug. (b) Preview side-by-side uses @media (min-width: 1400px); below that, gs-preview-toggle collapsible is used at 390 AND 1280. (c) Theme toggle on desktop lives inside the user avatar dropdown (top-right chevron); only data-testid=theme-toggle-mobile is exposed on mobile/narrow layouts. Dark-mode legibility was not deep-tested — main agent may self-verify. (d) FirstRunRedirect auto-redirect intentionally does not fire for the 6-brand owner account.
